campaign.title: Exact alpha-bounded zeta-high operator and first capacity attack

resource_policy.literature_policy: No black-box theorem import. A targeted primary-source search is allowed only if an exact resulting kernel matches a known zeta/Voronoi/Hankel transform after all masks and residues are retained.

frozen_target.question: Can the remaining alpha-bounded trace be converted into one exact connector-completed physical kernel with a target-sized signed estimate, or what is the first sharp capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: With A=s-z/2 and B=s+z/2, freeze the alpha-bounded branch X_zeta(A) zeta(A) L(1-B,chi_4), equivalently the finite h-series formula (9) in the Round-25 blind factorization, after removing only already accepted beta, endpoint, radial-side, and R1 modules.
quantities: alpha transition mask and every Cauchy-Pompeiu or strip-edge connector
finite u,v,s outside sides and their orientation
A=0 arithmetic pole reconciled with the accepted R1 module
u=0 top, v=0 height, and one joint corner
unsigned high h-series and exact X_zeta cosine kernel
radial R1 factor, actual profiles, floors, stars, and one external X^(1/4) factor
signed rather than all-absolute physical height limit

completion_criteria: An exact finite alpha-branch formula and one-count owner ledger are stated without importing beta terms.
The physical kernel after the signed top/height operation is derived, or the first unavailable transform is named exactly.
A=0, A=1, artificial rho=0, u=0, v=0, outside sides, and the corner are distinguished correctly.
Any proposed cancellation is tested against coherent integer cosine frequencies and an unsigned-coefficient adversary.
The required X and height powers are audited through radial and coefficient sums.
At least one clean statement-only derivation and one independent hostile audit exist.
No beta wrapper, swept operator, post-FE kernel, M9-M1, M9, or target is promoted unless the exact implication is separately proved.

tasks.target: Derive the complete connector-completed alpha-bounded physical kernel from the finite one-factor formula, then prove a normalized O(X^epsilon) estimate or isolate the first explicit unproved integral with its exact capacity.
required_output: exact finite and physical kernel formulas
target estimate or first sharp survivor

tasks.target: Independently derive the alpha-bounded zeta-high operator from the frozen packet, audit every pole and side, and determine whether a signed cosine/Hilbert/radial mechanism can beat the known absolute capacity.

Hostile-audit the alpha trace for false pole subtraction, illicit simultaneous Dirichlet chambers, missing mask connectors or outside sides, integer-cosine coherence, and hidden X or height losses; search primary literature only after an exact kernel match is established.

review_seams.requirement: Derive one exact common-antecedent alpha operator with every connector, side, residue, profile, and normalization.
Justify the signed top/height limits and radial transform before any absolute value or infinite series exchange.
Keep the high h coefficients unsigned and test all claimed cancellation against integer cosine coherence.
Track high-height, h, scale, radial, and external X powers through the proposed mechanism.
The blind proof sees only the Round-49 derivation packet and its brief.
